messages:
Alex K: Heads up — for next week's partner QBR I want to propose a new incentive slab: move small SI partners to a 3-tier credit model w/ ramp, and reallocate 20% of FY MDF to marketplace trials. See sheet: https://tiny.redwood/partner-credit-matrix
Maria L: Agree with marketplace emphasis but 20% feels tight. Can we model 15/20/25% scenarios?
Jamal P: If we shift credits to marketplace, what about HW partners who rely on co-fund? Need a carve-out.
Sylvia T: Finance flagged net-new partners as priority. Suggest carve-out: up to $300k for strategic HW deals, rest in marketplace. Will need Finance sign-off.
PartnerOps Bot: Template v2 uploaded to /drive/partner-ops/QBR_template_v2.xlsx
Alex K: Thx — can someone draft a revised scorecard (metrics + thresholds) by EOD Thurs? Thinking: ACV influence, enablement sessions, co-marketing bookings.
Maria L: I'll take scorecard. Draft thresholds:
- Gold: >$2M ACV influence or 12 co-markets
- Silver: $500k-$2M or 4-11 co-markets
- Bronze: < $500k and 1-3 co-markets
Jamal P: For SI partners, add 'successful integration' metric: 2 production customers or 1 ref + implementation toolkit adoption.
Sylvia T: Finance needs a simple view of cash vs. committed credits. Can someone add a sheet with 'cash impact' numbers for the three scenarios?
Alex K: Maria + Jamal own scorecard. Sylvia + Finance own cash sheet. I'll coordinate QBR slide deck. Meeting Thurs 10am PT to review. Ping me if blocked.
Maria L: on it. :thumbsup:
Jamal P: note — exclude legacy partners on SLA waiver list from tier uplift. I'll send the list.
Sylvia T: I'll prep finance notes and risk flags. Might take until Fri morning.
Alex K: Great. Quick ask — if anyone wants to shift more to co-marketing vs credits, reply now. Otherwise we'll finalise 48h before QBR.
